description: This file defines the Api model class within the Opencart system, providing methods for API login, session management, and token validation.
external_files: db/ query execution and escaping functions

classes.name: Api
classes.description: A model class for handling API authentication and session management within the Opencart system.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with username and key, returning API info as an array.

methods.name: getApiByToken
methods.description: Retrieves API details associated with a provided session token.

methods.name: getSessions
methods.description: Retrieves all session records for a specific API ID.

methods.name: deleteSessions
methods.description: Deletes session records that are outdated based on modification time and API ID.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Updates the 'date_modified' timestamp of a session to keep it alive.
